title: Borealis Health — QBR + Roadmap demo: narrow window & fallback sync
text:
Borealis Health — QBR + Roadmap demo: narrow window & fallback sync

['From: Alex Torres <atorres@borealishealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@borealishealth.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: QBR + roadmap demo — narrow windows this week?

Hi Priyom,

Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing the agenda for our renewal QBR and roadmap demo next week and want to pin down a time that works for our execs and engineering leads. Our execs are only available the afternoons of Tue/Wed (PST) and we need a separate 45‑minute tech breakout for the platform team.

Can Redwood do either:
- Tue 29 Jun, 1:30–2:30pm PT (exec + 45m tech after)
- Wed 30 Jun, 3:00–4:00pm PT (exec + 45m tech separate)

If neither works, can you propose two adjacent slots you can commit to and a fallback plan if our exec becomes unavail? Also, procurement will need a SoW for the expansion scope — I’ve copied procurement@borealishealth.com so they can flag required docs.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres
Head of Platform Initiatives
Borealis Health

Attachments: none
', 'From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — narrow windows this week?

Alex — thanks for the clear windows. We can support either day but would like to propose a small variation to reduce risk and satisfy both exec and tech needs:

Proposed plan (two options):
1) Tue 29 Jun, 12:30–1:00pm PT — 30‑min exec demo (concise overview and business impacts)
   Tue 29 Jun, 1:15–2:00pm PT — 45‑min technical breakout (deep dive + Q&A)

2) Wed 30 Jun, 2:30–3:00pm PT — 30‑min exec demo
   Wed 30 Jun, 3:15–4:00pm PT — 45‑min technical breakout

If your execs prefer a single contiguous meeting we can do Tue 29 Jun, 1:00–2:15pm PT (75 min total) and record the session for anyone who misses the tech breakout.

Fallback plan: if exec availability shifts at the last minute we’ll: 1) run the exec portion with a Redwood AE and a pre‑recorded 10‑minute tech snippet; 2) immediately schedule the 45‑min tech session within 48 hours; 3) provide a short notes pack and follow‑up action items.

I’ve attached a suggested agenda and a 1‑page runbook for the demo (format: PDF). Can you confirm which of the two options you prefer and whether procurement needs an updated SOW template or a signed draft?

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Borealis_QBR_Agenda.pdf (stub)
', 'From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — narrow windows this week?

Adding a quick ops note — Priyom’s plan looks good. One small ask from our side: if we go with the Tue option, can we move the exec slot to 12:45–1:15pm PT to give a 15‑minute buffer for the tech team to set up? That prevents overlap and reduces the risk of starting late.

Also, if procurement needs a SoW, we have a standard expansion SOW (v2) and a short addendum for data retention and Private deployment options. Happy to share and start a DocuSign route if you confirm the slot.

— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Quoted:
> On Fri, 25 Jun 2027 at 09:15 Alex Torres <atorres@borealishealth.com> wrote:
> > Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing the agenda for our renewal QBR and roadmap demo next week and want to pin down a time that works for our execs and engineering leads.
', 'From: Alex Torres <atorres@borealishealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@borealishealth.com>, procurement@borealishealth.com
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — narrow windows this week?

Thanks Priyom/Kimberly — we like option 1 on Tue and Kimberly’s buffer is fine. Final preference:

Tue 29 Jun
- Exec: 12:45–1:15pm PT
- Tech breakout: 1:30–2:15pm PT

Procurement — we’ll need the SOW and a high-level pricing estimate to start the internal approval. If Redwood can route a DocuSign link for the SOW draft, procurement will expedite review.

I’ll tentatively block the times and share a calendar invite once we have the DocuSign.

— Alex

Quoted:
> On Fri, 25 Jun 2027 at 11:20 Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > One small ask from our side: if we go with the Tue option, can we move the exec slot to 12:45–1:15pm PT to give a 15‑minute buffer for the tech team to set up?
', 'From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, procurement@borealishealth.com
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — narrow windows this week?

Alex — great, thanks for confirming. A couple operational points from my side:

- We’ll record the exec demo and provide a 2‑page highlights memo immediately after. That should cover any execs who can’t attend.
- During the 45‑min tech breakout we’ll bring the runtime engineering lead and an infra PM to cover dedicated/private deployment considerations and QA.
- I’ve asked our legal/finance team to prep the expansion SOW (SOW‑draft‑v2.docx). If procurement confirms the email, I’ll send a DocuSign envelope by EOD Monday.

Logistics ask: please confirm the final attendee list for both sessions (names + roles) and whether the breakout requires VPN access or an SSH sample dataset. If you expect a handful of engineers to want network access, we’ll provision a temporary test tenant.

Next steps:
1) Priyom to send calendar invites and the agenda (attached previously).
2) I’ll route the DocuSign SOW link to procurement (see link below) once procurement confirms preferred signatories.
3) Kimberly will manage the recording/notes.

— Vivek
VP, Customer Engineering — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SOW-draft-v2.docx (stub)
Related link: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABCDE12345
', 'From: Alex Torres <atorres@borealishealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@borealishealth.com>, procurement@borealishealth.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR + roadmap demo — narrow windows this week?

All — confirmed and thanks. We’ll plan for the Tue cadence you outlined. Procurement has reviewed the SOW and accepted the draft with two minor edits (billing cadence + data retention clause). I’ve attached a redline and the procurement contact is copying in a signatory this afternoon.

We’ll accept the DocuSign envelope and I’ll send the finalized attendee list by EOD Tuesday. Looking forward to the demo.

— Alex

Attachments: Borealis_SOW_redline.pdf (stub)
